title: font current show --json
description: This machine's current font, read from its local history and size file with no terminal and no sync. family, applied_at and trigger come from the latest apply this machine recorded, and are null when it has recorded none. Another machine's apply never counts, because it never reached this screen.

family.description: The font family the latest apply wrote to every terminal, under the name the font registry uses.

size.description: This machine's chosen terminal size in points, which size-up and size-down move. It is meant for 0.74em digits, and each terminal shows it scaled to the font's own digit width. Null until the first apply or size change records one.

applied_at.description: When the latest apply ran, in UTC.

trigger.description: Who applied it: manual for a command typed by hand, schedule for the timer.
